basis_note: field-confirmed 2026-06-27 (okoa-website fleet, GLM-5.2 on Pi): embedded newlines submit one line per prompt (machine-gunning), jamming the recipient; two boot stalls 2026-06-20 sweep. Compose single-line; helpers auto-flatten as backstop.

events.notes: Multi-line boot contract arrived fragmented; pi processed each line as a separate submission and stalled waiting for the rest. Re-sent as one single-line message with ' ;; ' separators.

events.crash_signature_summary: machine-gunning: embedded \n in a single send submitted line-by-line; recipient jammed and burned context
events.recovery_action: auto-flatten newlines/CR/tabs to single spaces in the send helper before the one submit
events.notes: The trigger is the embedded newline itself, not multiple send calls; prose rules alone did not prevent it — the safe path must flatten automatically.

message_format.notes: Submits on EVERY newline. Compose the entire message as ONE line with ' ;; ' field separators; flatten \n/CR/tab to spaces before the single submit.

recommended.notes: Single-line-only harness: never send embedded newlines (machine-gunning); use ' ;; ' separators; one atomic submit
